cells.label: Monthly summary

config.source:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', INVOICE_DATE) AS month, SEGMENT AS segment,
       SUM(NET_CENTS) AS net_cents, SUM(PAID_CENTS) AS paid_cents,
       SUM(PAID_CENTS) / NULLIF(SUM(NET_CENTS), 0) AS payment_rate,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NET_CENTS > 0 THEN CUSTOMER_ID END) AS invoiced_active_customers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PAID_CENTS > 0 THEN CUSTOMER_ID END) AS active_customers
FROM enriched WHERE STATUS = 'posted'
  AND TENANT_ID = {{ tenant }}
  AND INVOICE_DATE >= CAST({{ start_date }} AS DATE)
  AND INVOICE_DATE < CAST({{ end_date }} AS DATE)
  AND ({{ segment }} = 'ALL' OR SEGMENT = {{ segment }})
GROUP BY MONTH, SEGMENT ORDER BY MONTH, SEGMENT

cells.label: Current invoices

config.source:
WITH invoice_versions AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID ORDER BY SEQUENCE DESC) AS RN
  FROM DMA_HEX.RAW.INVOICE_CDC
), payment_versions AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TENANT_ID, PAYMENT_ID ORDER BY SEQUENCE DESC) AS RN
  FROM DMA_HEX.RAW.PAYMENT_CDC
), payments AS (
  SELECT TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID, SUM(PAID_CENTS) AS PAID_CENTS
  FROM payment_versions WHERE RN = 1 AND NOT IS_DELETED
  GROUP BY TENANT_ID, INVOICE_ID
), history AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TENANT_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, SEGMENT, VALID_FROM, VALID_TO
  FROM DMA_HEX.RAW.CUSTOMER_HISTORY
)
SELECT i.TENANT_ID, i.INVOICE_ID, i.CUSTOMER_ID,
       CAST(i.INVOICE_DATE AS DATE) AS INVOICE_DATE,
       i.AMOUNT_CENTS, LOWER(TRIM(i.STATUS)) AS STATUS,
       COALESCE(p.PAID_CENTS, 0) AS PAID_CENTS, h.SEGMENT
FROM invoice_versions i
LEFT JOIN payments p ON i.TENANT_ID = p.TENANT_ID AND i.INVOICE_ID = p.INVOICE_ID
LEFT JOIN history h ON i.TENANT_ID = h.TENANT_ID AND i.CUSTOMER_ID = h.CUSTOMER_ID
  AND CAST(i.INVOICE_DATE AS DATE) >= CAST(h.VALID_FROM AS DATE)
  AND (CAST(i.INVOICE_DATE AS DATE) < CAST(h.VALID_TO AS DATE) OR h.VALID_TO IS NULL)
WHERE i.RN = 1 AND NOT i.IS_DELETED

config.source:
import pandas as pd
adjustments = pd.read_csv("adjustments.csv")
enriched = invoice_base.merge(adjustments, on=["TENANT_ID", "INVOICE_ID"], how="left", validate="many_to_one")
enriched["ADJUSTMENT_CENTS"] = enriched["ADJUSTMENT_CENTS"].fillna(0).astype(int)
enriched["NET_CENTS"] = enriched["AMOUNT_CENTS"] + enriched["ADJUSTMENT_CENTS"]
enriched["OUTSTANDING_CENTS"] = enriched["NET_CENTS"] - enriched["PAID_CENTS"]
